verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's reading order and hierarchy intact (logo, kicker, product, 30% OFF, copy, CTA, legal) with clean centring. Its flaws are that it is mostly the portrait layout padded out sideways rather than rearranged, the legal line is tiny, and the bottom-left circle leaves dead space. B breaks the order. The 'SUNSET SALE' kicker drops below the body copy and legal line and sits jammed against the CTA. The logo shrinks into the bottom-left corner on top of an overlapping circle. The red circle is stretched into an ellipse behind the CTA, and the top band is empty while the bottom is crowded.
